name: lh2-studio
description: LightHouse Studio: Lighthouse 2 base-station editor, auto-calibration and drone tracking (desktop app)
author: Davide Lentini, Eduardo Gonzalez

scripts.dist:win: npm run prepare-app -- --backend && npm run fetch-python-win && electron-builder --win --x64 -c.win.signAndEditExecutable=true
scripts.dist:win-dir: npm run prepare-app -- --backend && npm run fetch-python-win && electron-builder --win dir --x64
scripts.dist:win-zip: npm run prepare-app -- --backend && npm run fetch-python-win && electron-builder --win zip --x64
